sceneCharacterOutfitsText: CHARACTER OUTFITS: Емілія: Floral bomber jacket with colorful embroidery, casual sneakers (outfit o_emilia_bomber_sneakers). Флеш: natural appearance. Сяйвик: natural appearance.

sceneVisual.setting: Outside the porthole, a gigantic glass-sphere ship drifts in space: a transparent orb filled with dense jungle-like greenery, visible as a huge green mass with tangled silhouettes. The orb catches distant starlight with soft reflections on the glass. Inside the cabin, a few tiny floating dust motes shimmer in the light, watercolor-soft and gentle.
sceneVisual.lighting: Soft, cool starlight entering through the porthole from the left, creating gentle bluish highlights on faces and cabin panels; the distant star's glow makes the glass-sphere ship shimmer with translucent reflections; overall watercolor wash with subtle paper texture and no harsh shadows.

cameraComposition.shot: Medium-wide shot at child eye-level from inside the shuttle, framing the porthole on the left and the three friends clustered near it; the glass-sphere greenhouse ship clearly visible through the window as the main background focal point

characters.name: Емілія
characters.description: Left foreground beside the porthole ledge, leaning forward with her nose close to the cool glass, one arm extended and index finger pointing directly toward the huge green glass-sphere ship outside; eyes wide and excited, ponytail arcing slightly as if swaying with the shuttle's motion.

characters.name: Флеш
characters.description: Center foreground on the cabin floor near Emilia's legs, bouncing on short paws with an eager grin, clutching a small wooden stick with leaves in one paw; lightning-bolt tail flicking upward, gaze locked on the glass-sphere ship through the porthole.

characters.name: Сяйвик
characters.description: Upper center near the cabin ceiling, gently circling in place and scattering delicate white sparkles that drift downward; head turned toward the porthole, calm and curious expression.

expectedCharacters.name: Флеш
expectedCharacters.description: Round yellow body with small green spots; zigzag lightning tail; white eyes red pupils; red mane; wooden stick with leaves; short limbs

expectedCharacters.name: Сяйвик
expectedCharacters.description: Small light-blue fluffy spark creature; large round head; white antennae with balls; translucent wings; short limbs

expectedCharacters.name: Емілія
expectedCharacters.description: Young girl (7–9); light skin; freckles; rainbow braids / multicolor hair; expressive face
expectedCharacters.expectedOutfitForScene: Floral bomber jacket with colorful embroidery, casual sneakers
